blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Makabayan bloc lawmakers from the House of Representatives on Wednesday sought an investigation into the disasters happening in landfills across the country. They also want to know the implications of these events on the safety, health and livelihood of affected waste workers and nearby communities. ACT Teachers Party-list Rep. Antonio Tinio, Kabataan
